summary: Iteration 11 — Mongo-backed chunked upload + GridFS video persistence/streaming fallback FULLY VERIFIED. 11/11 backend tests PASS in 12.85s (new file /app/backend/tests/test_mongo_chunks_gridfs_iter11.py). Verified: (1) POST /api/uploads/chunk stores chunks as binary in db.upload_chunks with exact 3MB size preserved, cumulative 'received' count is correct across 3 chunks including a chunk_b64 base64 variant; (2) POST /api/analyses/finalize counts+reads chunks from Mongo in chunk_index order, assembled local file size == exact sum of chunk bytes (9,437,184 bytes for the 3x3MB happy path), and all upload_chunks docs for that upload_id are deleted after finalize; (3) Retry/idempotency: uploading the same chunk_index twice does NOT double-count (received stays at 1 after 2 POSTs of index 0), the SECOND payload (BBBB) overwrites the first (AAAA) as expected from the upsert; (4) Validations return correct 400/401: unknown upload_id -> 400 'Upload not found', incomplete 2 of 3 -> 400 'Upload incomplete: 2/3 chunks received', bad upload_id ('../evil') -> 400, unauth -> 401; (5) GridFS fallback: after finalize (.mp4, no ffmpeg conversion needed), db.videos.files gets a filename=<analysis_id> entry with length equal to the payload size within ~9s; renaming the local file to .hidden and hitting GET /api/analyses/{id}/video?token=demo_coach_token returns 200 with BYTE-IDENTICAL content streamed from GridFS; missing token still returns 401; (6) TTL index on upload_chunks.created_at with expireAfterSeconds=86400 and unique compound index on (user_id, upload_id, chunk_index) both present; (7) Regressions green: legacy POST /api/analyses returns 200 processing in <10s, /api/plans returns 200, / serves HTML.

Real user uploads will still land in status=failed unless gemini-2.5-pro succeeds first. Not blocking this iteration's multi-replica fix, but blocks end-to-end user success.

Assembly reads each chunk doc into memory via db.upload_chunks.find(query).sort('chunk_index', 1) and writes to disk in-order. Motor loads each document fully (each chunk is up to 16MB by BSON limit; frontend uses 3MB so safe today). Fine for current 3MB frontend chunk size but keep this in mind if chunk size is ever bumped.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:upload_chunk (745-786) — replace_one upsert on (user_id, upload_id, chunk_index) makes the endpoint idempotent by design; unique compound index enforces the invariant even under a race. Verified in test_reupload_same_chunk_index_no_double_count.

server.py:finalize_chunked_upload (796-830) — counts from Mongo, asserts received == total_chunks, reads sorted by chunk_index, writes to local file, deletes chunks. Correct multi-replica-safe design: any replica can finalize because storage is shared. Verified assembled bytes == sum of chunk bytes AND ordering (first bytes of chunk 0 match the retry, first bytes of chunk 1 match c1).

server.py:_store_video_in_gridfs (937-951) — deletes any pre-existing videos.files entry with the same filename before uploading (idempotent) and swallows exceptions with logger.exception so a GridFS failure does not crash the bg task. Verified videos.files entry created with correct length within ~9s of finalize.

server.py:get_analysis_video (1038-1074) — path check + FileResponse for the local-file happy path, then a try/except open_download_stream_by_name('videos', filename=analysis_id) fallback that streams chunks lazily. Fallback verified byte-identical to the uploaded payload.
server.py:_ensure_indexes (1664-1677) — TTL 86400s on created_at plus unique compound (user_id, upload_id, chunk_index). Both present, both verified.

rca_of_issue: Original bug: 'Upload failed: 400 {detail: Upload incomplete: 8/9 chunks received}' on the deployed site (2 replicas behind a load balancer). RCA: chunks were written to LOCAL POD DISK inside /app/backend/uploads/chunks/<user_id>/<upload_id>/ — with 2 replicas, chunks split across pods and finalize on any single replica only saw its own pod's slice, never all 9. Same class of bug also affected GET /api/analyses/{id}/video: the video was written to local disk by whichever pod handled finalize, and other pods returned 404 'Video file missing'. Fix (verified iter 11): (a) chunks moved to db.upload_chunks with replace_one upsert on (user_id, upload_id, chunk_index) so any replica writes to the same shared store; received count is now count_documents in Mongo. (b) finalize reads all chunk docs sorted by chunk_index from Mongo, assembles local file, deletes chunk docs. (c) videos are additionally persisted to GridFS bucket 'videos' with filename=analysis_id in the background task, and GET /video falls back to streaming from GridFS when the local file is missing (other-replica case). (d) startup ensures TTL 86400s on created_at + unique compound index so retries are safe and orphaned uploads auto-expire. Reproduction of the fix: uploaded 3x3MB chunks (one via chunk_b64), verified BinData docs in db.upload_chunks with size==3MB each and correct chunk_index; finalized -> assembled file bytes == 9437184 == sum of chunks; retried chunk_index=0 twice -> received count stayed at 1 (upsert working); manually renamed the local video file away and confirmed GET /video?token=... returned the same bytes from GridFS. Mitigation for future: keep this test file in CI and monitor the 'GridFS store failed for %s' logger.exception line for silent failures.
